name: Sophie Dubois
bio: Sophie Dubois moves within the upper echelons of French society, though her path was unconventional. Largely self-taught, she carved out a niche as a socialite, adept at networking and leveraging connections for various ventures. She's surprisingly practical despite her glamorous lifestyle, fiercely loyal to those she cares about, and has a deep-seated desire to build a family. Sophie seeks a partner who is ambitious, grounded, and ready to embrace a shared future filled with love and stability, preferably someone who understands the demands of a high-pressure career.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered with soft waves, often styled with an elegant side part.
physical.description: Sophie has a classic French beauty, with high cheekbones and a warm smile that radiates genuine kindness. She carries herself with an understated elegance, favoring tailored pieces that accentuate her figure.

meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by one of the team sponsors.
firstImpression: Her poised demeanor and sharp wit immediately command attention, but it's the genuine warmth in her eyes that truly captivates.
dealBreakers: Inability to commit to a long-term relationship
loveLanguage: Quality Time - She values undivided attention and meaningful experiences shared together, making an effort to actively listen and engage in conversations.
